stem: How does the author organize the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: By explaining the origin of the Keep Calm motto and its current popularity, the author emphasizes how the motto's use has changed over time.

options.label: B
options.text: By comparing the way the Keep Calm motto was used during World War II with the way it is used today, the author suggests that the motto's effectiveness has diminished.

options.label: C
options.text: By describing in detail each reason the Keep Calm motto has become an important part of popular culture today, the author identifies why the motto's popularity has increased.

options.label: D
options.text: By stating the cause of the development of the original Keep Calm motto, the author shows how the motto has become an answer to many problems.
